Subject: Pilot needs extra runway — request for temporary credit boost

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks again for the kickoff last week. Our engineering team has run into higher token usage than expected during the integration tests. We're about halfway through the two-week PLG pilot but will exhaust the trial credits in ~48 hours at the current rate.

Can Redwood issue a short-lived top-up so we can finish the pilot smoke tests and validate the evals? Ideally a single-use promo code or one-off voucher for roughly $3,000 of credits (or 600k tokens) that expires in 30 days. This is critical for us to complete the SSO and data pipeline validation on time.

I've attached the pilot scope and a brief usage snapshot. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Integrations
Acme Software
